title: Ordinary constant quotient modules under completed extension
statement: For the chart and completed coefficient data in [def-weil-pbc-finite-perfect-adic-scalar-realization], the exact ordinary functor from algebraic A/I^(n+1)-modules obtained by universe transport, etale constants, comparison inverse image, pro-etale inverse image, and explicit scalar realization is naturally isomorphic to restriction to A followed by ordinary completed constant realization and slice restriction. The isomorphisms commute with the ordinary consecutive source and target compositors. No derived category, algebraic tower, or perfectness assumption is used.

source.place: Tags 093J, 093M and 03CY; Cohomology on Sites Tag 06YY; Derived Categories Tag 05RU.

proof.text: Constant sheafification commutes with the two inverse images, weakly etale restriction and slice transport by the constant-section units. The locally bijective finite scalar presentation identifies associated fixed-ring modules with modules over the actual quotient sheaf.

Send a completed pure tensor b tensor m to pi_n(b)m. Completed finite reduction makes this invertible on the free rank-one quotient module. Coproducts and cokernels, applied to a free presentation, extend the comparison to every quotient module and prove naturality.

Both consecutive composites send b tensor m to pi_n(b)m by the equation between completed projections. Sheafification and presentation uniqueness give exactly the specified ordinary compositor equation.

proof_origin.place: Exact constants and completed finite reduction, followed by exact-functor localization.

theorem finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalar_model
    (X : Scheme.{t}) {A : Type t} [CommRing A] (d : AdicCoefficientDatum A)
    (V : X.Etale) (U : V.left.ProEt) (W : X.ProEt)
    (f : W ⟶ finitePerfectAdicChartObject V U) :
    ∃ e : ∀ n : ℕ, finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSource X d V U W f n ≅
        finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarTarget X d W n,
      ∀ (n : ℕ) (N : ModuleCat.{t} (A ⧸ d.ideal ^ (n + 1))),
        (e (n + 1)).hom.app
            ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars
              (Ideal.Quotient.factorPowSucc d.ideal (n + 1))).obj N) ≫
          (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarTargetStep X d W n).hom.app N =
        (finitePerfectAdicOrdinaryScalarSourceStep X d V U W f n).hom.app N ≫
          (e n).hom.app N
